note: San Diego County park on the open summit above Sweetwater Reservoir in Bonita; the northern loops look down over grassland to the reservoir about 300 m off. Twelve equestrian partial-hookup sites (24-28, 36-40, 42, 44) share the southern loop with ordinary partial-hookup sites 33-35, 41, 43 and 45. --Claude
